content: समाहारः .²1 A collection, an aggregate, assemblage; <ls>Māl. 9</ls>; ततः कपिसमाहारमेकनिश्चायमागतम् <ls>Bk. 7. 34</ls>. .²2 Composition of words. .²3 Conjunction of words or sentences. .²4 A subdivision of {%Dvandva%} and {%Dvigu%} compounds expressing an aggregate (as त्रिभुवनम्). .²5 Abridgment, contraction, conciseness. .²6 Combination of two letters of the alphabet into a syllable (= प्रत्याहार <ab>q. v.</ab>).
